s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive dyspnea and joint pain in a patient with a history of rheumatic heart disease
salient_findings: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
key_facts: 36-year-old woman with rheumatic mitral stenosis
Status post mitral valvotomy and two valve repairs
Received streptokinase for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis two weeks earlier
Experienced fever and bilateral knee pain over the past 3 days
No photosensitivity, rashes, myalgia, malaise, or lymphadenopathy
Hemoglobin 9.65 g/dL
Neutrophils 41%, lymphocytes 43%, platelets 4,456,000/µL
Prothrombin time 32.8 s, INR 2.5
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and positive C-reactive protein
Blood and urine cultures were sterile
Serologic tests for hepatitis B surface antigen, antinuclear antibody, anti–cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, and lactate dehydrogenase were negative

differentials: Tumor Necrosis Factor Receptor-Associated Periodic Syndrome
per_call: Tumor Necrosis Factor Receptor-Associated Periodic Syndrome

shortlist.label: Infective Endocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of rheumatic heart disease and recent valve repairs, with current symptoms of fever and joint pain, which are consistent with infective endocarditis

shortlist.label: Poststreptococcal Reactive Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of rheumatic heart disease and recent streptokinase treatment, with current symptoms of fever and bilateral knee pain, which are consistent with poststreptococcal reactive arthritis

shortlist.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of prosthetic valve repairs and recent streptokinase treatment, with current symptoms of progressive dyspnea, which could be related to prosthetic valve thrombosis

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has symptoms of joint pain and elevated inflammatory markers, which could be consistent with rheumatoid arthritis

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of valve repairs and recent thrombotic event, with current symptoms of dyspnea and joint pain, which could be related to antiphospholipid syndrome

raw.rationale: The patient's recent history of streptokinase treatment for suspected prosthetic mitral valve thrombosis and the development of fever and bilateral knee pain without other systemic symptoms are consistent with poststreptococcal reactive arthritis, especially given the lack of evidence for infection or other autoimmune conditions.

rejected.label: Infective Endocarditis
rejected.why: Sterile blood and urine cultures do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Prosthetic Valve Thrombosis
rejected.why: Recent treatment with streptokinase would have addressed this issue, and current symptoms do not align with thrombosis

rejected.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
rejected.why: Negative anti–cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody and lack of other characteristic symptoms make this less likely

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid Syndrome
rejected.why: Negative serologic tests and lack of thrombotic events or other specific symptoms do not support this diagnosis
